notes: Reference-card direction (2026-09-15). Dillon's note on the first weekly set: the copy was a label list, not information. These three are built to be screenshotted and kept -- a real 14-day rotation comparison, a real mediation/court comparison, and an annotated example message. Dense, editorial, infographic-led; no scrapbook craft styling. Palette from the approved 2026-09-12-sunburst-social deliverables: cream #F6F2E9, deep navy #0E303A, teal #5599A8, aqua #A9D3DD, brass #C89A4A, coral #D58A74. Every prompt names its on-image text exactly and bans invented extra text, because the 2026-09-14 square test invented three folder labels that were not in the prompt. Every prompt reserves a clean lower-right patch; generate.py composites the real frozen logo there, never the model. Format feed_portrait (1088x1360). No legal advice, no outcome promises, no invented law, no client stories, no statistics -- a number the model invents would be a fabricated claim on a law firm's page. No em dashes in on-image text. 2026-09-15 contrast revision: the first generation put teal #5599A8 small text on cream (3.27:1) and white numerals on mid-tone discs (2.26:1 to 3.30:1), both measured failures. Teal text is now pinned to #246E7E, the disclaimer grey to #4A4A45, and every numeral is navy on a pale tint. One teal cannot be both a fill and a surface under text.
